name: ecode 0.9.0
body:
**ecode 0.9.0 is one of the largest releases in the project's history.** It significantly expands ecode's Git tooling, editor customization, terminal capabilities, debugging workflow, system integration, and performance, while also incorporating a large amount of stability and rendering work from eepp.

Major additions include the ability to run the complete ecode GUI directly inside compatible terminals, VS Code-compatible user snippets, an integrated Git conflict resolver and Git History browser, a centralized searchable Settings interface, Zen Mode, persistent and navigable Markdown previews, configurable file associations, richer debugger layouts, Git diff indicators, improved font and text rendering controls, and a substantially upgraded integrated terminal.

## Highlights

### Run the full ecode GUI inside a terminal

ecode can now run its **complete graphical interface directly inside a terminal** that supports the Kitty graphics protocol.

Launch it with:

```sh
EEPP_RUNTIME=terminal ecode
```

This is not a separate TUI implementation or a simplified terminal frontend. ecode runs through the same eepp application, widget, editor, rendering, and input architecture used by the native desktop application.

In terminal runtime mode, eepp renders the application into an offscreen framebuffer and presents the resulting RGB frames through the Kitty graphics protocol. Terminal input is translated back into the normal eepp input pipeline, including keyboard, mouse, focus, and resize events.

The runtime includes:

* Full ecode GUI rendering inside the terminal
* Kitty graphics framebuffer presentation
* Persistent Kitty image updates
* Tile-based damage detection and unchanged-frame suppression
* Adaptive zlib compression and chunked Base64 frame streaming
* Kitty keyboard protocol input
* SGR pixel mouse input
* Focus events
* Terminal pixel-size resize handling
* Cross-platform terminal lifecycle support
* Hidden native graphics-context hosts where required by the platform

Because this is implemented at the eepp runtime layer rather than specifically in ecode, the same terminal runtime architecture can also be used by other eepp GUI applications.

And, yes: **ecode can now run inside ecode.** Launching `EEPP_RUNTIME=terminal ecode` from ecode's own integrated terminal renders a fully interactive ecode instance inside the terminal of another ecode instance. Apart from being a fun demonstration, it is also a useful illustration of the fact that terminal mode is a real application runtime rather than a separate text-based frontend.

This enables workflows that normally require a native graphical session while retaining the ergonomics of terminal environments, including terminal multiplexers, remote shells, and terminal-managed tabs and sessions.

As far as we know, ecode is the first native GUI code editor to ship this capability as a built-in application runtime rather than through a separate terminal frontend or browser-based wrapper.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cf6d2987-7300-4832-abe5-d638b7fb57f1


### Zen Mode

ecode now includes a **Zen Mode** for distraction-free editing.

Zen Mode can be toggled from the **View** menu, through its keyboard command, or started directly with:

```sh
ecode --zen-mode
```

While active, ecode hides the side panel, status bar, menu controls, tab bar, and document information, leaving the editor content as the focus. Leaving Zen Mode restores the previously configured visibility of those interface elements.

This also provides a much lighter single-file editing experience when ecode is launched from a file manager or used as a quick editor.

SpartanJ/ecode#964

### VS Code-compatible user snippets

ecode now supports user-defined snippets in addition to snippets provided by language servers.

Snippets can be loaded from language-specific and global configuration, project-local `.ecode` files, and compatible `.vscode` snippet files.

The implementation supports:

* JSONC snippet files
* Language and scope filtering
* Hot reload
* Source-aware completion ranking
* Exact prefix replacement
* Context-aware indentation
* Multi-cursor insertion
* Tab stops and final cursor positions
* Linked placeholders
* Placeholder choices
* Variables and transformations
* Common case-conversion modifiers
* Workspace-relative include and exclude globs

A new **Insert Snippet** provider is also available from the Universal Locator, making snippets searchable even when they are not triggered through autocomplete.

Importing VS Code snippets can be disabled independently while keeping personal and `.ecode` snippets enabled.

SpartanJ/ecode#111

### Major Git workflow improvements

ecode's Git integration has been substantially expanded.

A new integrated three-pane conflict-resolution workflow provides:

* Ours, result, and theirs views
* An editable shared result document
* Conflict navigation
* Accept-current, accept-incoming, and related conflict actions
* Live diff highlighting
* Synchronized scrolling
* Conflict staging and resolution
* Restoring and discarding conflicted files
* Continue, commit, and abort actions for paused Git operations
* Session restoration for conflicts already in progress

Git History is now available directly from the source-control interface and as a detached tab. It supports browsing `HEAD`, local branches, remote branches, and tags without checking them out, and includes:

* Incremental history loading
* Expandable merge commits
* A synthetic **Working Tree / Index** entry for uncommitted changes
* Commit metadata and full messages
* Changed-file statistics
* Multi-file commit diffs
* Unified and side-by-side diff modes
* **Show in Git History**
* Checkout, merge, fast-forward merge, cherry-pick, and revert actions
* Branch and tag creation
* Local, remote-branch, and tag deletion
* Copy commit ID and commit message actions
* **Add Tag & Push**
* Persistent history table layout and column widths

The Git status view now supports multi-selection for stage, unstage, discard, open, and diff operations. Multiple selected files can be opened together in a single multi-file diff view.

Untracked files can now be deleted directly from Git status after confirmation, including correctly handling Git-quoted paths.

Diff views gained shared multi-file controls, aggregate change statistics, global expand/collapse actions, and a configurable default between unified and side-by-side presentation.

Remote branch handling now excludes symbolic entries such as `origin/HEAD`, removes stale local tracking references after remote deletion, and prunes stale refs while pulling.

### Git diff indicators

ecode can now display Git additions, modifications, and removals directly in the editor gutter and minimap.

Diff computation runs asynchronously against the repository baseline and handles unsaved changes, newly added files, repository changes, stale jobs, and external file reloads.

The feature and its debounce interval are configurable from ecode settings.

SpartanJ/ecode#955

### Persistent Markdown previews and local navigation

Markdown previews are now much closer to document browsers rather than static renderings.

Local Markdown links can be followed relative to the current document, including relative `file://` paths. ecode previews maintain optional Back/Forward history, expose navigation actions from the context menu, and support `Mod+[` / `Mod+]` history shortcuts.

Markdown preview tabs are now restored between sessions. When navigating away from a preview and then going back, ecode preserves the live editor binding and can continue rendering unsaved source content from the associated document.

Markdown and HTML views also gained document-level text selection, including forward and reverse dragging across independent rich-text elements, autoscroll, **Copy**, **Select All**, and selection-aware context menus.

### Centralized Settings interface

ecode now provides centralized, searchable **User Settings** and **Project Settings** panels.

Settings are organized into categories and subsections, supported options update in real time, editable values are validated, and the older settings menus have been simplified to retain only contextual actions.

Plugin settings are integrated into the same interface. Plugins can expose structured options including:

* Boolean settings
* Choices
* Editable values
* Lists
* Secrets
* JSON objects
* Grouped settings

Raw JSON configuration remains available for advanced use cases.

The Settings UI is also constructed lazily, reducing startup work and avoiding the cost of creating large settings menus before they are opened.

### Cross-platform file associations

ecode can now manage file associations from the Settings panel on Windows, macOS, Linux, and FreeBSD/XDG environments.

The interface exposes extensions known by ecode's syntax definitions and applies association changes asynchronously.

On XDG systems it can also install the ecode desktop entry required for the associations.

SpartanJ/ecode#192

### Integrated terminal upgrades

Separately from the new application-level terminal runtime, ecode's **integrated terminal** received a major architectural and compatibility update.

Terminal emulation and parsing now run away from the UI thread, reducing the amount of terminal work that can block editor rendering.

The shared terminal implementation used by ecode gained:

* Kitty Graphics Protocol support
* Kitty keyboard protocol support
* Improved graphics streaming and frame replacement
* Application cursor and keypad mode fixes
* More complete modified-key handling
* Improved frame-damage detection
* Better scrollback synchronization
* Selection preservation while output arrives
* More reliable scrollbar interaction
* Correct Shift override behavior for application mouse reporting
* Improved mouse-wheel handling
* Better search highlighting
* Smarter find-bar placement so matches are not obscured
* Correct focus reporting without unexpectedly jumping scrollback to the bottom
* Improved IME positioning when switching between editor and terminal focus
* Improved drag selection bounds and vertical autoscroll when selecting beyond the terminal viewport

A large amount of terminal rendering and protocol processing was also optimized to reduce allocations and redundant work.

### Font, text, and rendering improvements

ecode now exposes configurable OpenType shaping features separately for editor text and general UI text.

Supported feature tags include:

* `liga`
* `calt`
* `clig`
* `dlig`

Changes are applied immediately and persisted in the configuration.

The system-font resolver was substantially improved. Native fallback matching is now used on supported platforms, including Fontconfig, DirectWrite, and Core Text, with lazy missing-glyph resolution and cached fallback results.

Font discovery no longer needs to eagerly enumerate every installed font during startup.

The font picker can now select both font and size for ecode's UI, editor, and terminal font settings.

SpartanJ/ecode#944

The rendering stack also gained subpixel/LCD text rendering improvements used by terminal and HTML surfaces, including single-pass rendering and fixes for scaled glyph atlases.

Custom fallback fonts no longer replace ecode's built-in CJK fallback font, and several native font-family/style resolution issues were fixed.

### AI Assistant improvements

The AI Assistant can now fetch and cache a dynamic model catalog, while keeping bundled models as an offline fallback.

New model metadata and controls include:

* Reasoning capability information
* Configurable reasoning effort
* Updated model selection after catalog refresh
* Provider-aware model discovery
* API keys for arbitrary configured providers
* Provider prioritization when credentials are available
* Improved title-generation model selection
* Persisted reasoning configuration in chats

Model-catalog loading is deferred from the startup critical path.

ACP Agent message chunk ordering was also fixed, and empty assistant messages are no longer sent to providers that reject them.

### Customizable debugger layouts

Debugger tabs can now be moved and split between the bottom panel and a reusable right-side panel.

The debugger remembers:

* Tab placement
* Split layout
* Panel state
* Table column widths

Column widths can use pixel or percentage sizing, and project-relative source paths are now shown in debugger stack frames.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5067b7ed-dbee-433b-9664-a613b3d99ee9


## Editor improvements

* Added configurable **Tab Out** behavior for moving a single cursor past selected closing characters instead of inserting indentation. It is disabled by default and does not change selection or multi-cursor indentation behavior. SpartanJ/ecode#951
* Added `-r` / `--read-only` for opening command-line files in read-only mode. The state is preserved when files are forwarded to an existing ecode instance. SpartanJ/ecode#954
* Improved the Home / move-to-start-of-content behavior to match common editor behavior more closely. SpartanJ/ecode#935
* Added an exit command to `UIConsole`, allowing the console to be hidden through the command system. SpartanJ/ecode#937
* Line wrapping is now enabled by default for new installations.
* Fixed commands that incorrectly executed against the editor where they were registered instead of the currently active editor.
* Fixed restoration of the correct find/replace state.
* Fixed splitter bookkeeping when editor or generic-widget tabs are moved between splits, preventing focus, title, selection, and callback state from falling out of sync. SpartanJ/ecode#958
* Fixed the cursor jumping to an old viewport position when clicking inside a scrolled editor split. SpartanJ/ecode#958
* Fixed a range of HiDPI / pixel-density inconsistencies affecting the editor, console, diff and merge views, font picker, tooltips, and AI Assistant UI.
* Improved bulk document insertion and IME-location updates.
* Improved editor initialization when opening many documents.
* Improved multi-file diff loading and creation.
* Improved caret placement around shaped ligatures.
* Improved read-only state handling and lock toggling.
* Improved editor wrap-content and scrollbar sizing.

## Search and project indexing

* Hardened asynchronous document search against stale results, rapid query changes, cancellation races, document replacement, and editor destruction. SpartanJ/ecode#956
* Fixed a global-search crash that could occur when switching between asynchronous replace-in-files and normal document/global search before the replace model had finished loading.
* Fixed an autocomplete crash caused by document-symbol workers racing document lifecycle updates.
* Newly created directories are now indexed after the initial project scan, making their contents immediately available to the Universal Locator.
* Live project indexing now applies `.gitignore`, `.prjallowed`, and `.prjdisallowed` filtering consistently to files and directories added after project load.
* Improved asynchronous filesystem-event processing with batching, modification coalescing, safer listener removal, and main-thread model updates.
* Added cross-directory move handling while preserving tree selections, descendant paths, lazy destination branches, and the paths of already-open documents.
* Fixed stale filesystem-model indexes and queued-delete use-after-free conditions that could crash project/file views.
* Improved synchronization between project-tree mutation and active searches.
* Fixed live project-tree updates for files and directories added directly to the project root, including files moved into the project from outside the tree.

## Git and diff improvements

* Added multi-file Git status actions for stage, unstage, discard, open, and diff.
* Added multi-file diff tabs with aggregate changed-file and line statistics.
* Added a configurable default diff presentation: **Unified** or **Side by Side**.
* Added deletion of untracked files and groups directly from Git status.
* Added discard support for conflicted files and conflict groups.
* Added **Add Tag & Push**.
* Improved local, remote, and tag management from Git History.
* Fixed stale and symbolic remote branch entries.
* Fixed merge-view copy commands in read-only source panes.
* Improved Git plugin initialization and asynchronous UI lifetime handling.
* Git diff gutter/minimap state now refreshes correctly after an external file reload.
* Local branches without a matching fetched remote ref are now clearly identified as local-only.
* Fixed binary renames being incorrectly represented as untracked files in Git status.
* Fixed remote-branch checkout for nested branch names and ensured newly created local branches receive the correct upstream tracking configuration.
* Improved image diff views: source images and generated diffs are displayed at native pixel dimensions when possible, with corrected HiDPI sizing and reliable mode-button hit testing.

## Debugger improvements

* Added customizable bottom/right debugger layouts with movable and splittable tabs.
* Persist debugger panel state, table column widths, and splitter layouts.
* Display project-relative paths in stack frames.
* Fixed a crash when attaching to a local PID with an incomplete debugger command.
* Fixed cases where the debugger plugin did not initialize correctly.
* Fixed debugger status-panel serialization.
* Fixed response delivery to multiple debugger listeners so payload data is preserved for every listener.

## Screenshots

ecode now includes a configurable screenshot command, available from the Window settings and bound to **Print Screen** by default.

Screenshot destination, file-name pattern, and image format can be configured. Successful captures can be opened in ecode's integrated image viewer, and the notification also offers an action to open the containing folder.

SpartanJ/ecode#950

## File and application integration

* Replaced ecode's filesystem-watcher-based local IPC with a cross-platform message-oriented IPC implementation using Unix-domain sockets on POSIX systems and named pipes on Windows.
* Open-file forwarding remains profile-scoped and preserves the existing first/latest-instance behavior.
* Added cross-platform file-association management. SpartanJ/ecode#192
* Improved file association handling on macOS.
* The Project Tree now remembers **Show Hidden Files** between sessions.
* Improved recursive directory deletion portability.
* Added cross-directory filesystem move support for open projects.
* Fixed saving `.vapi` files while `vala-language-server` is active. SpartanJ/ecode#939

## macOS improvements

ecode now uses eepp's native macOS global menu-bar integration instead of the previous hand-written Cocoa menu.

Native menus preserve ecode's lazy submenus, shortcuts, checkboxes, radio items, enabled/visible state, and semantic About, Preferences, Quit, Window, Help, and Services integration.

Duplicate shortcut execution between AppKit and SDL was also fixed.

SpartanJ/ecode#823

Additional macOS work includes improved Core Text font-family and face resolution, faster native font lookup, file-association fixes, and updated nightly build handling.

## Windows and clipboard improvements

* Fixed crashes and path corruption involving Unicode executable and working-directory paths on Windows. SpartanJ/ecode#953
* Improved Windows clipboard reliability by retrying writes when the clipboard is temporarily unavailable.
* Added SDL 3 MIME-based non-text clipboard support.
* Fixed bidirectional clipboard support in Emscripten builds.
* Improved MSVC build compatibility in several shared components.

## Performance

A significant part of this release comes from eepp-level optimization work that directly benefits ecode.

Notable improvements include:

* Optimized `UICodeEditor` minimap rendering and several common rendering hot paths; the implementation work measured roughly a 10% render-time improvement in representative ecode scenarios.
* Deferred construction of large settings menus and settings-panel entries until they are actually needed.
* Reduced allocations during editor creation, project saving, document insertion, selection handling, UI updates, and multi-file diff preparation.
* Moved common `Variant` values to inline storage, reducing heap churn in table/tree-heavy interfaces such as Git History, debugger views, and project models.
* Accelerated UTF-8 / UTF-32 conversion and codepoint counting using a reduced simdutf integration while retaining scalar fast paths where appropriate.
* Reused regular-expression match data and bounded the regular-expression pattern cache.
* Improved native system-font resolution so fallback work is performed lazily instead of eagerly enumerating all fonts.
* Optimized syntax tokenization for common small result sets.
* Improved stylesheet matching, invalidation batching, and UI hot paths.
* Optimized terminal output processing, frame-damage detection, graphics decoding, and Kitty image streaming.
* Reduced startup work by moving AI model-catalog loading and other non-critical initialization off the first-frame path.
* Reduced redundant rich-text rebuilds, inline-fragment invalidations, and HTML table layout work, improving Markdown/HTML preview rendering and resize behavior.
* Optimized asynchronous UI resource dispatch to avoid heap allocation in the common path while preserving the correct scene context.

## Stability and correctness

* Hardened asynchronous document search and cancellation. SpartanJ/ecode#956
* Fixed split-view callbacks and focus tracking after moving tabs between editor splits. SpartanJ/ecode#958
* Fixed a Windows Unicode-path crash and an AI Assistant teardown fault during partial initialization. SpartanJ/ecode#953
* Reworked plugin shutdown so editor commands, listeners, clients, UI objects, and queued callbacks are detached safely on the main thread before resource destruction.
* Prevented plugin reloads and stale command dispatch during application shutdown.
* Fixed an autocomplete document-symbol race that could corrupt its internal document set.
* Fixed stale `FileSystemModel` indexes, queued-delete use-after-free conditions, and several project-tree mutation races.
* Fixed a global-search / replace-in-files timing crash.
* Fixed an Oniguruma fallback-pattern deallocation bug that could corrupt the heap in regex users including snippet parsing.
* Fixed custom fallback fonts replacing the built-in CJK fallback.
* Fixed a font fallback use-after-free during missing-glyph resolution.
* Fixed terminal scrollback, selection, focus, application-cursor, and mouse-report synchronization issues.
* Fixed terminal search highlight and find-bar placement issues.
* Fixed opening/closing a terminal context menu unexpectedly moving scrollback.
* Fixed duplicate mouse-wheel events and several multi-window input-routing regressions in shared UI code.
* Fixed `UIDropDown` positioning, sizing, and table sort-indicator issues.
* Fixed multiple asynchronous UI lifetime hazards in Git History and other ecode controllers.
* Fixed `UIConsole` keyboard/wheel scrolling and moved-entry cache handling.
* Fixed several memory, resource-lifetime, and shutdown issues in shared graphics, font, HTTP, and UI infrastructure.
* Added regression coverage for the multi-instance shutdown crash reported in SpartanJ/ecode#959, including worker-released texture cleanup across engine restarts.
* Fixed additional project-root path canonicalization and filesystem-event regressions affecting live project updates.

## HTML and Markdown preview improvements

The eepp HTML/CSS stack received extensive work that improves ecode's Markdown and HTML rendering surfaces.

Changes include:

* Added persistent Markdown preview tabs with local-link navigation and Back/Forward history.
* Added document-level text selection to Markdown and HTML views, including copy, select-all, context menus, nested-content selection, and autoscroll.
* Fixed text selection being accidentally started by unrelated editor or scrollbar drags.
* Improved mixed-font baseline alignment in rich-text content.
* Fixed Markdown view styling so it inherits the correct base-theme CSS.
* Improved large-page loading to avoid long UI stalls.
* Improved render culling.
* Improved CSS cascade ordering for deferred stylesheets.
* Fixed CSS comments inside declarations and statement at-rules.
* Improved inline, inline-block, float, flex, and replaced-element layout.
* Fixed percentage margins and percentage-sized inline SVG rendering.
* Improved SVG HiDPI rendering.
* Improved form-control sizing and styling.
* Improved background shorthand parsing, sizing, clipping, and multi-layer behavior.
* Improved borders, border radii, patterned borders, and paint ordering.
* Improved whitespace collapsing and rich-text positioning.
* Improved font-weight, fallback-font, and `@font-face` resolution.
* Fixed several rich-text float placement and layout loops.

## Interface and usability

* Added optional smooth scrolling support across shared scrollable UI widgets.
* Improved dropdown sizing and placement.
* Improved table sorting indicators and prevented accidental sorts after header dragging.
* Improved shared table/tree interactions so selections survive sorting and context-menu opening more reliably, with better column-header dragging behavior.
* Improved settings-panel mouse interaction, keyboard navigation, focus behavior, and validation.
* Improved native font picker behavior for external fonts and asynchronously discovered fonts.
* Improved multi-file diff controls and changed-file summaries.
* Improved UI event lifetime handling and mouse-wheel bubbling.
* Added secondary modifier support to the shared input/keybinding system.
* Updated English, German, French, and Chinese translation resources for the new settings and features.

name: ecode 0.8.1
body:
# Changelog

ecode 0.8.1 adds LSP snippet support, a built-in scientific calculator, a new system font picker, configurable tab placement, date and time insertion, new syntax definitions, and numerous improvements to stability, performance, file dialogs, AI assistance, localization, and editor behavior.

## Highlights

### LSP snippet support

ecode now expands snippets received through LSP completion responses.

The new snippet editing mode supports:

* Tab stops and final cursor positions
* Linked placeholders
* Placeholder choices
* Snippet variables and transformations
* Visual placeholder feedback
* Navigation using Tab and Shift+Tab
* Multi-cursor snippet insertion

This currently applies to snippets provided by language servers. Support for user-defined snippets is planned separately.

SpartanJ/ecode#111, SpartanJ/ecode#933

### Built-in scientific calculator

The Universal Bar can now evaluate mathematical expressions directly, without opening a terminal or leaving the editor.

It supports common arithmetic operations, constants, and scientific functions such as trigonometric functions, logarithms, powers, and square roots.

SpartanJ/ecode#701

### New system font picker

ecode now includes a full font picker dialog capable of discovering installed system fonts and selecting the font family, style, and size with a live preview.

The new dialog is used by ecode’s font-selection settings and replaces the previous basic file-oriented font selection workflow.

SpartanJ/ecode#903

### Configurable new-tab placement

A new **New Tab Position** setting controls where newly opened tabs are placed.

Available positions include:

* After the active tab
* Before the active tab
* At the beginning of the tab bar
* At the end of the tab bar

The selected behavior now applies consistently to all newly created tabs.

SpartanJ/ecode#904

### Insert date and time

New editor commands can insert the current date, time, or date and time into the active document.

The commands are available from **Edit → Insert Date** and can also be assigned custom keybindings.

SpartanJ/ecode#173

## Editor improvements

* Added optional documentation display to the LSP signature-help popup. Documentation is enabled by default. SpartanJ/ecode#911
* Fixed a crash that could occur while displaying LSP signature help or autocomplete information. SpartanJ/ecode#902
* Improved overriding of inherited LSP server configurations, including `command_parameters`, making it possible to customize language-specific configurations without modifying their parent template. SpartanJ/ecode#913
* Fixed custom keybindings being overwritten or removed when ecode merged newly introduced default bindings into the user configuration. SpartanJ/ecode#914
* Recently closed files now preserve their cursor and focus state when reopened during the same session. State is tracked independently for each editor view. SpartanJ/ecode#893
* Fixed horizontal scrolling remaining available when line wrapping was configured to break at a specific column. SpartanJ/ecode#915
* Improved the display of keyboard shortcuts in menus for commands that previously omitted them.
* Fixed a use-after-free condition in the code-editor splitter.
* Improved handling of mixed or unexpected line endings in files otherwise detected as CRLF.

## File dialogs

* Pasting an absolute directory path into the file-name field of the folder chooser now navigates to and opens that directory when valid. SpartanJ/ecode#872
* Improved file-picker behavior and integration throughout ecode.
* Fixed row selection behavior when interacting with the file dialog’s text input.
* Improved dropdown-list scrolling used by dialogs and other interface elements.

## AI Assistant

* Fixed a crash that could occur while cancelling an AI Assistant request. SpartanJ/ecode#906
* Improved AI Assistant request handling and error behavior.
* Added further configuration capabilities for supported AI providers.

## Search and performance

* Project-wide search now uses memory-mapped access for large files and reduces unnecessary allocations, improving search performance and memory usage on large projects.
* Improved UI and stylesheet matching performance through optimized CSS selector indexing, cached hashes, faster attribute matching, and reduced layout overhead.
* Improved application shutdown and asynchronous resource cleanup, reducing leaks, stale callbacks, and shutdown-time crashes.
* Fixed several graphics, font, SVG, OpenGL-context, HTTP, TLS, and resource-lifetime issues.

## Syntax highlighting

* Added syntax highlighting for Gemini protocol documents using the `.gmi` extension. SpartanJ/ecode#917
* Registered Genie source files, temporarily using Python syntax highlighting until a dedicated definition is available. SpartanJ/ecode#924
* Registered `.vapi` files as Vala source code. SpartanJ/ecode#925
* Registered `.meson` files as Meson source files. SpartanJ/ecode#926
* Added recognition for CMake `.in` files.
* Improved Vala function-call detection.
* Added and pre-registered several additional file extensions and syntax definitions.

## Localization

* Fixed Chinese language resource loading by using the expected ISO 639-1 language identifier and renaming the translation resource accordingly. SpartanJ/ecode#908
* Updated German, French, Chinese, and English translation resources.
* Corrected several translated strings and removed outdated entries.

## Interface and usability

* Removed trailing ellipses from menu actions that execute immediately rather than requesting additional user input. SpartanJ/ecode#892
* Improved Breeze theme styling and consistency.
* Improved font discovery and native font-weight/style resolution.
* Improved scrolling visibility and layout behavior in several UI components.
* ecode now respects SDL hints explicitly configured by the user instead of unconditionally replacing them with internal defaults. SpartanJ/ecode#921
* Window raising behavior was improved on supported SDL versions.

## Stability fixes

* Fixed crashes related to LSP signature help and completion handling. SpartanJ/ecode#902
* Fixed AI Assistant request-cancellation crashes. SpartanJ/ecode#906
* Fixed a code-editor splitter use-after-free.
* Fixed unsafe asynchronous UI resource deliveries during application shutdown.
* Fixed several HTTP request cancellation, callback re-entry, and shutdown issues.
* Fixed socket initialization and failed TLS-handshake cleanup.
* Fixed OpenGL context and SVG resource leaks.
* Fixed stale image and layout resource caching.
* Fixed several editor, layout, rendering, and resource-lifetime race conditions.

## Build and platform support

* Added preliminary SDL 3 build support to Windows and MinGW build scripts through the `--backend=sdl3` option.
* Improved Windows ARM64 nightly builds.
* Improved macOS and Windows build compatibility.
* Updated bundled dependencies, including efsw and SOIL2.
* GLEW is now disabled by default while the renderer transitions away from the dependency.

## Additional fixes

* Improved HTML, Markdown preview, and rich-text layout behavior.
* Fixed CSS variable resolution, specificity, font-weight selection, `box-sizing`, percentage sizing, floats, flex layouts, inline blocks, whitespace handling, and image sizing.
* Fixed HTML documents containing a UTF-8 byte-order mark.
* Improved UIWebView resource loading, local-path resolution, font handling, isolation, hit testing, and asynchronous cleanup.
* Fixed incorrect external-resource loading attempts for non-URL paths.
* Improved memory management and deterministic application shutdown.

name: ecode 0.7.4
body:
# Changelog

## Added

* Added text shaping and text segmentation support.
* Added `duplicate-line-or-selection` text document command.
* Added an option to reuse the previously launched terminal (#710).
* Added the option to link files in AI Assistant chat (instead of attaching directly).
* Added terminal cursor styles selection at `Settings -> Terminal -> Cursor Styles`.
* Added scrollbar type and mode options for the terminal.
* Added an option to configure the `Settings -> Window -> "Use editor font in input fields"` (this is enabled by default but not always convenient).
* Added an option to "Use status bar terminal" in the Run configuration.
* Light/dark theme now follows the system default configuration (#754).
* Terminal status bar now is a tab widget and can create any number of terminals.
* Added an option to configure to open new terminals in status bar panel (`Settings -> Terminal -> New Terminal Behavior`.
* Added option to force opening documents in main split (`Settings -> Window -> Open Documents in Main Split`).
* Added syntax highlighting for Vim Language, FreeBASIC, QB64.
* Added strip ANSI Codes option in build and run settings (for the build and run outputs).
* Added an option to set to always open terminal in exclusve mode (#800).
* Added `reset-global-file-associations` (`Window -> Reset Global File Associations`) and `reset-project-file-associations` (`Window -> Reset Project File Associations`) commands to reset language extension priorities for languages that can be represented by more than one language grammar.
* Added support for maximizing the current tab widget (commands: `maximize-tab-widget` and `restore-maximized-tab-widget`), it can also be triggered right clicking a tab -> `Maximize Tab Widget` (#651).
* Added an option to reset panel layout (#675).

## Improved

* AI Chat UI has been slightly improved / redesigned.
* Improve editor "add-cursor-above" and "add-cursor-below" behavior.
* Grammars in many languages: C, C++, C#, Objective-C, Objective-C++, Markdown, PowerShell, SmallBasic, and more.
* Terminal emulator capabilities.
* File Save now defaults to the most recent save location (#734).
* Side Panel: right click on a directory and open it on new window (#736).
* Side Panel right click context menu improvements (#712).
* Side Panel: Right click on a sub-directory and "Find in folder..." (#720).
* LM Studio models are now supported in AI Assistant plugin.
* Show the ecode version on the Welcome Screen (#752).
* Improved drop-down lists width in several locations.
* Add auto-scroll when selecting and mouse cursor moves out of vertical view range in terminal.
* Improve bitmap fonts support.
* Enabled syntax highlighting in auto-complete list by default (for the newly created profiles).
* Allow to expand/contract status bar panel.
* Language extension priorities are now per-project (this is when you pick which language grammar use when more than one is available for an specific file extension).
* Display a download progress window when download-file-web is used. Also support loading images and sounds from downloads.

## Fixed

* Many fixes for the LSP plugin implementation which brings better general support to LSPs, which also fixes #694, #742 and #766.
	* Implemented workspace/didChangeConfiguration command in LSP client. Now it's possible to set LSP settings for this command (#694).
	* Prevent dead-locks in LSP *very* heavy usage scenarios
* Many fixes to the terminal emulator (closes issues #740 and #800).
	* In TerminalEmulator allow to select text outside the visible range.
	* Fix minor bug when changing terminal font and creating a new terminal was still using the old font.
	* Terminal: multiple issues with the copy/paste operations fixed. Now uses the primary selection when corresponds (middle mouse click, shift+insert). Fixed paste operation, it does not hang the app, pastes instantly contents and behaves exactly the same as other terminals.
* Many fixes in the DAP implementation.
	* Fix environment not being inherited in debuggee.
* Minor fixes in native file dialogs (#706)
* Fix ca-bundle path on macOS (fixes ecode macOS app not working through TLS since I moved the assets path).
* Fixes in process kill behavior in Windows.
* Build and Run: fix run in terminal on Windows 8.1 (#740).
* Fixed various crashes related to closing a LLM chat tab while executing an HTTP request.
* Fix in Markdown folding ranges.
* Fix rare crash in debugger when dealing with multi-session DAP.
* Fix unbinded buttons in side panel when ecode is started with `-t` CLI parameter (#755).
* Fix how selection in terminal is enabled or disabled based on the reported application capabilities.
* Fix overlapping shortcuts and terminal shortcuts in terminal.
* Take into account the line spacing to position the cursor.
* Fix underline and strikethrough size when top and bottom positions are the same due to the small difference generated by the underline thickness (otherwise it was sometimes invisible).
* Fix paste with middle-click in OSes with no primary selection.
* Fix move event not being handled correctly within the FileSystemModel fileIsVisibleFn configuration (discussed at: [SpartanJ/ecode/discussions#776](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/discussions/776)).
* Fix opening nonexistent files from CLI.
* Correctly handle Private mode queries in the terminal emulator implementation.
* Fix crash when drag & dropping images into ecode.
* Fix Windows temp path resolution.

* Added **Assembly (ARM)** syntax highlighting support ([#78](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/78)).
* New **JEdit syntax color scheme** ([#660](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/660)).
* Added a visual feedback when an open buffer has been deleted from disk ([#608](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/608)).
* Added automatic detection of the language used in `.h` files and the possibility of picking the language manually if necessary (`Settings -> Folder/Project Settings -> Treat .h files as...`) ([#614](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/614)).
* Command-line option `--no-plugins` to launch without plugins ([#635](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/635)).
* Command-line option `--profile` to start with a specific profile ([#634](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/634)).
* Added command **toggle-block-comment** [#604](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/604).
* Added commands **convert-indentation-to-tabs** and **convert-indentation-to-spaces** ([#667](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/667)).
* Added command **delete-to-start-of-line** ([#668](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/668)).
* Added command **join-lines** ([#669](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/669)).
* Added commands **move-to-previous-paragraph**, **move-to-next-paragraph**, **select-paragraph**, **delete-paragraph** ([#670](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/670)).
* Added commands **fold**, **unfold**, **toggle-fold**, **fold-all**, **unfold-all** ([#683](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/683)).
* **Crash reports** are now stored inside the user **profile directory** ([#639](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/639)).
* Added a way to **quit the shell and close the terminal tab** in one step (`Settings -> Terminal -> Close Terminal Tab on Exit`) ([#643](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/643)).
* Better default behavior when **closing a terminal tab with a running command** (`Settings -> Terminal -> Warn Before Closing Tab`) ([#644](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/644)).

## Improved

* macOS startup time
* Internal windows shadows

## Fixed

* A lot of invalid memory access bugs that could provoke crashes (a lot of work has been put into this).
* **Segmentation fault** when working with split panes ([#650](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/650)).
* Fixed issue where **plugins could crash on reload**.
* Fixed a crash when typing > at beginning of line in front of another character [#622](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/622).
* Fix possible dead-lock while closing / destructing in LinterPlugin.
* Fixed a bug when dragging of zero-sized files into ecode ([#623](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/623)).

To run `ecode.app` on macOS Sequoia, you need to perform a one-time step due to Apple's security requirements for unsigned apps:

We're working on signing the app with an Apple Developer ID for a smoother experience in future updates.

name: ecode 0.7.1
body:
### New Features

*   **AI Assistant Plugin**: ([Docs](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/blob/main/docs/aiassistant.md)) Interact directly with a wide range of local and remote Large Language Models (LLMs) from providers like Google, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Mistral, Ollama, and LM Studio. This initial version provides a dedicated chat UI within the editor. *Future updates will focus on deeper project integration (e.g., context awareness).*

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ae8ca06c-d88c-4c8b-a6bc-877f0d5ff83a


*   **Discord Rich Presence Plugin**: Showcase your coding activity in Discord! This plugin integrates with your Discord client to display your current file and status. (Huge thanks to **@bytequill** for this contribution!)

*   **Expanded Syntax Highlighting**: Added support for 17 new languages: Blade, C3, CovScript, Fennel, Flow9, Janet, Jule, Lisp, Modula 2, Modula 3, Rave, Squirrel, Svelte, V1, YueScript, Zephir, and Ü.

*   **New Language Server Protocol (LSP) Support**: Enhanced code intelligence (completion, diagnostics, etc.) for C3, Lisp, Markdown, and Ü.

*   **Debugging Support**: Added debugging capabilities for the Ü language.

*   **Tab Stop Alignment**: Implemented proper tab stop support, ensuring consistent alignment when using tab characters ([SpartanJ/ecode#55](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/55)).

*   **Document Transformation Commands**: Added commands to quickly transform text:
    *   `escape` / `unescape`
    *   `to-base64` / `from-base64`
    *(These operate on the current selection or the entire document if no text is selected).*

*   **Improved Fuzzy Matching**: Introduced a new, more effective fuzzy matching algorithm (inspired by Sublime Text's approach) for significantly better results when searching for files, symbols, commands, etc.

*   **Open All Files in Folder**: Added a convenient context menu option (`Right-click > Open All Files in Folder`) in the file tree view.

### Improvements

*   **Documentation**: Significantly improved documentation coverage and clarity across the project.

*   **Git Plugin**: Enhanced stability and functionality. For example, the branch list now indicates if a tracked remote branch no longer exists (origin gone).

*   **Emoji Rendering**: Color emoji fonts now render correctly with the proper size and color, even within monospaced text contexts.

*   **Performance**: Optimized whitespace rendering performance on wrapped lines, making it as fast as non-wrapped lines.

*   **User Experience**: Improved handling of user-defined `fallback-font` settings, ensuring the default fallback font is always loaded reliably.

*   **Build System**: Addressed issue where specifying a non-existent working directory for a build step was not handled gracefully ([SpartanJ/ecode#432](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/432)).

### Bug Fixes

*   Fixed text wrapping not updating correctly after zooming when 'Wrap to Line Breaking Column' was enabled ([SpartanJ/ecode#390](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/390)).

*   Fixed a crash when using 'Cursor Undo' (`Ctrl/Cmd+U`) with only one cursor present ([SpartanJ/ecode#389](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/389)).

*   Fixed a potential crash when pasting from an empty clipboard ([SpartanJ/ecode#428](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/428)).

*   Fixed a crash when running `ecode` in terminal mode (`ecode -t`) ([SpartanJ/ecode#391](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/391)).

*   Fixed the file tree view not updating correctly after renaming a folder.

*   Fixed numerous issues within the debugger plugin for increased stability.

*   Fixed the debugger gutter background sometimes not rendering correctly.

*   Fixed the horizontal scrollbar sometimes appearing unnecessarily on wrapped documents.

*   Fixed an issue where syntax highlighting could be incorrect on the first line of a file.

*   Fixed issues with project search path filters not applying correctly.

*   Fixed a rare issue preventing scrollbars from appearing in the project view.

*   Includes numerous other minor stability improvements and fixes.

name: ecode 0.6.4
body:
Yet another small release with bug fixes and performance improvements

* Added OCaml syntax highlighting support (thanks to @mdales!) and [ocaml-lsp](https://github.com/ocaml/ocaml-lsp) support.
* Added Julia LSP support using [LanguageServer.jl](https://github.com/julia-vscode/LanguageServer.jl).
* Added Fortran LSP support using [fortls](https://github.com/fortran-lang/fortls), plus some syntax highlighting improvements.
* Added perl LSP support using [PerlNavigator](https://github.com/bscan/PerlNavigator), plus some syntax highlighting improvements..
* Added double click over the tab bar (on an empty space) will now open a new untitled document (issue #361).
* Added animated gif support in image previews.
* Allow to locate and open image files from the universal locator.
* Optimized multiple cursors selection (issue #356).
* Optimized how the file system directory is fetched when loading a single file from file system, now it will load asynchronously, avoiding hanging the application on very large directories (issue #357).
* Fixed using new line with multi-cursors in the same line (SpartanJ/ecode#364).
* Fixed linter errors and warnings being incorrectly positioned when the line was wrapped.

name: ecode 0.6.2
body:
Another small release with some nice improvements and many important fixes.

* When files are opened from a file explorer or from the command line and there is currently a running ecode instance files will be loaded in the last ecode instance instead of launching a new ecode instance. Option to toggle this is at `Settings -> Window -> Open Files in New Window`, which is disabled by default (issue #58).
* Added Regular Expressions support in all searches (document and global) (issue #147).
* Added Regular Expressions support in syntax highlighter (issue #225).
* Display subfolder hint/info when two or more files have the same file name but different paths.

![subfolder-hint](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ebb8a6a5-00f0-4afc-a185-4acb52d49fb4)

* ecode now offers nightly builds available from [here](https://github.com/SpartanJ/eepp/releases/tag/nightly).
* ecode releases can now be triggered from Github Actions, simplifying the work required for new releases (this will probably translate in more frequent releases).
* Improvements in syntax highlighting for CMake files and Makefiles.
* Improved theming support, now changing themes during the same instance should work correctly (before this some colors glitched and were not applied properly, a restart was needed).

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/794148d7-e5c9-4a71-a56b-bb63617486fd

* Added a glob match for path and extension search in the "Locate" bar (write "g your_glob_match") (issue #336).
* Added keybindings to the Auto Complete plugin. Now user can customize how auto-complete is triggered and consumed (issue #336).
* Improvements in command palette fuzzy search.
* Added a new document command to select a whole line ("select-single-line"), this differs from the normal "select-line" command that will select only the contents in the line without the last new line character (issue #340).
* Added support for Windows Shortcuts (.lnk files).
* Added Windows arm64 builds.
* Updated German translation (thanks to @NullPlane).
* Fixed a critical crash ocurred when the application was run on low-memory scenarios due to an invalid memory access, it was critical when ecode was run from Haiku (issue #292).
* Fixed a critical crash when files were closed during its loading (issue #330).
* Fixed cursor selection not selecting while hovering over minimap (issue #333).
* Fixed general performance issues in Haiku (this was causing huge load times).
* Fixed `Recent Files` and `Recent Folders` buttons in Welcome Screen not being reactive (issue #339).
* Fixed a crash in build settings when adding or removing build steps and then writting into another step settings.
* Several performance optimizations for big files, large lines and also for rendering.
* And many more minor changes.

# ecode 0.6.0

This release adds some of the pending fundamental features for a code-editor.

## General

### Features

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6d56dfc6-ed9e-441f-8b02-a854290991a5

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/924e8805-9ff5-448a-bea4-9c4ffebb2cb5



Added support for session snapshots & periodic backup (editor will allow closing modified documents and restore its last state) (SpartanJ/ecode#220)


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f6982fc-dde4-4f6d-8503-71c32efce672



Improved distinction between modified and unmodified documents (SpartanJ/ecode#69 and SpartanJ/ecode#287)
Added Shift-JIS encoding support (SpartanJ/ecode#276)
Added [bend](https://higherorderco.com/) language syntax-highlighting support

### Fixes / Minor improvements

Fix Vue codes in <script> doesn't have syntax highlight (SpartanJ/ecode#275)
Fix don't run program if compilation failed when using project-build-and-run command (SpartanJ/ecode#278)
Allow to disable the Welcome Tab/Screen (and opening ecode with a blank document) (SpartanJ/ecode#279)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2c29bc11-8cfb-4a26-87bc-0fa21a727be8

Added Java Formatter-Support (SpartanJ/ecode#283)
Improvements in keywords for LSP Client ($FILEPATH and others) (SpartanJ/ecode#284)
Wrap text in linter tooltip (SpartanJ/ecode#289)
Fix pasting single-line text with multi-cursor
Fix haskell lsp command call
Fix a couple of rare crashes with observed file system changes
Plus many small improvements

## Notice

This new release could be a little bit more unstable than usual given that the new features represent a big change over the editor and text document components, adding document virtual views. I've using it for a couple of months, I'm confident with the soft-wrap implementation but not so much with code-folding given that I don't particularly use the feature very often. Please, as usual, report any issue. Also please note that code-folding is enabled in most languages but not all of them (tag based languages as XML/HTML are still pending unless you configure an LSP with fold support). Code-folding is provided from two different providers: ecode own implementation for languages with folding based in braces and indentation and also via LSP folding provider. If LSP fold provider is present ecode will prioritise it (it's expected to be better and faster). Tag based folding has not been implemented due to the processing cost it has (will need more dedication for an optimised implementation).

name: ecode 0.5.1
body:
# ecode 0.5.1

This release has a new big feature: Git integration plus many improvements and fixes.

## General

Added **Git Plugin**. This is an initial integration with Git, currently providing several useful utilities:
* Git status displayed in the status-bar, displaying current branch and number of changed lines (added/modified and removed).
* Project tree-view will highlight currently added and modified files.
* Git blame can be run on any line and will display a blame information tooltip.
* When opening a folder with a Git repo a new tab will be displayed at the side panel. This tab contains two main functionalities: Branches and Status.
        * Branches: In branches you'll be able to administrate your branches doing the basic and not so basic stuffs: pull, push, fetch, commit, locally renaming branches, merging branches and creating branches, fast-forward merge branches and more. Also managing stashes and tags. Sub-repositories branches are also manegable from here.
        * Status: Status will display the current status of the locally modified files. It will allow you to: stage, unstage, discard, view diffs and more plus managing the local branch with commit, fetch, pull push. Sub-repositories can also be managed from here.

https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/assets/650416/ae64d7de-8b20-40c0-998b-bc423e49da1a

![git-blame](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/assets/650416/39250011-7437-473a-af10-4b77b6431ca5)


Added file encoding detection and selection. Currently supporting UTF-8, UTF16-LE, UTF16-BE and ISO-8859-1 (Latin1) ([issue #126](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/126)).

Add portable mode ([issue #113](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/113)). Portable mode can be invoked by command line argument with `--portable` or `-p` or by creating a file besides the ecode binary called `portable_mode.txt`.

Added pony, GraphQL, MoonScript and blueprint lang support.

Several general visual improvements. Tabs visibility, scrollbars auto-hide, status-bar information.
![new look](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/assets/650416/13d2cf27-141c-419e-b0d4-13a149973cdd)

Semantic highlighting is enabled by default from now on.

Added context menu for tabs.

Tab widget now always keeps visible the currently focused tab.

Fixed an issue when reloading documents (with file system change) that disabled the linter by mistake.

Several improvements in syntax-highlighting for various languages.

Tabs now overflow text. For large named files it will display an ellipsis (...) and limit the maximum width of the tab.

Added catppuccin macchiato color scheme.

File type can be set from the universal locator (status bar `Locate` (Alt+1)) by using `ft ` command ([issue #127](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/127)).

Added command to select all words from current cursor to create multiple cursors with the default shortcut `ctrl/cmd+shift+d`.

Fixes in XML Tools plugin.

Added HTML formatting support with prettier.

Completed implementation for multi-language suppport (`Settings -> Window -> UI Language`). Currently languages are in development.

And many more bug fixes, general improvements and performance improvements.

Improved/reduced general memory usage.

Fixed an important memory leak that could be problematic for extended app usage.

## Windows Fixes

Fixed critical issue ecode deleting contents of files on Windows when filenames contains non-ascii names ([issue #114](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/114)).

Alt-tabbing on windows causes selected text to be deleted ([issue #115](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/115)).

Fixed ctrl+alt combination for text input on Windows ([issue #119](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/119)).

## macOS Fixes

Status bar color is now the app background color.

Removed titlebar separator.

Added scroll-momentum support.

Fixed opening links did not open the browser.

name: ecode 0.5.0
body:
# ecode 0.5.0

This is a stabilisation release and contains mostly bug fixes, but it also adds some cool new features.

# General

Added Jai, Verilog, Hare and Lobster syntax highlighting.

Improved Nelua and Odin syntax highlighting.

Added [IME](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Input_method) support (very important for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and many other languages).
![ime](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/assets/650416/e4a0384e-6bce-49bc-872e-f2d0eaa60909)

Added font-family support. Now default fonts will use real bold and italic versions of the font, editor now supports mixing different font stylings properly (see [before-styling](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/assets/650416/e6b2496a-8e2e-4774-9424-834d21b5061e) and [after-styling](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/assets/650416/fb879d05-4824-4644-b743-36a37b76a9fd) in "Spartan" color-scheme).

Several fixes and improvements for the build and build output system.

Greatly improved editor rendering performance (+80% performance improvement on average).

Slightly reduced memory usage of ecode.

Many fixes in all plugins.

LSP Client performance improvements.

Replaced default V LSP in favor of the new oficial LSP: [v-analyzer](https://github.com/v-analyzer/v-analyzer).

Added GLSL LSP support.

Ini configuration files now load around 10x faster (used for color schemes and config files).

Improved startup time.

Fixed a critical bug that crashed the application when a same document was being opened from two different editors and the first editor opened was closed and some document command was run after that.

Critical error fix when loading files of more than 1MB, sometimes they were loaded with some incorrect data.

Fixed an issue that provoked plugins to lose its configuration.

Allow selecting the default language for an extension when the extension could represent more than one language.

Terminal history/scrollback is now configurable.

Syntax Color Scheme now can support outline styling using: outline(thickness, color).

Minimap first-pass is now asynchronous and should not lock the UI.

Many improvements in tokenization performance.

Fixes for files not reloading when changed from disk.

Optimised document search (now is always asynchronous).

Added a new option un main menu to create a new instance of ecode (New Window).

The editor will display a file locked icon if the file is set as read-only (can be triggered with ctrl/cmd+shift+l).

And many more fixes!

# Windows fixes

Fixed a critical issue that would not allow the user to save the file with a false positive error of no write permissions ([issue #103](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/103)).

Temporal files used by linter and formatter are now hidden by default and will not flash on the project tree view.

# Linux fixes

Improved flatpak support.

# macOS fixes

Improved default macOS shortcuts.

Improved "Open with ecode”.

ecode now checks the PATH defined in the shell and append all pending PATHs to the current environment. This should improve binary finding (solves [issue #63](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/issues/63)).

Note: [ecode-macos-0.5.0-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/SpartanJ/ecode/releases/download/ecode-0.5.0/ecode-macos-0.5.0-arm64.dmg) has been re-uploaded on November 15 because it was incorrectly packaged.

name: ecode 0.4.3
body:
* Added support for **multi-cursor**!
	Default keybindings:
		Alt + Up: Create a cursor above the current cursor
		Alt + Down: Create a cursor below the current cursor
		Ctrl/Cmd + D: Add next occurrence (Select word + Select Next word with a new cursor)
		Ctrl/Cmd + U: Cursor Undo
		Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + A: Select all occurrences
		Alt + Shift + Click: Create a cursor on each line between the first cursor and the clicked line
		Ctrl/Cmd + Click: Create a cursor in the clicked area
		Escape: Reset cursor

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/650416/215363880-68710731-da81-4a21-81f7-c2db7f46e5a6.mp4
